summary: Comprehensive baseline accessibility review of the browser UI found one measurable non-text contrast defect.

findings.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: secondary button borders are below 3:1 contrast
findings.problem: The unhovered .button-secondary border (#aaa09e) has approximately 2.55:1 contrast against its white background, below the 3:1 required for visual information identifying user-interface components. This styling is used by secondary actions throughout the workspace, making their button boundaries difficult to distinguish for some users with low vision.

positive_changes: The UI primarily uses native buttons, form controls, labels, and a native modal dialog, with visible keyboard focus styling and a reduced-motion media query.
testing_recommendations: Recheck the secondary button border against both its white fill and the surrounding near-white page surface; retain at least 3:1 contrast.
recommended_actions: Darken the secondary-button border to a color that maintains at least 3:1 contrast in its default state.
